excerpt: Dubai Lamborghini rental prices for 2026: daily rates from AED 2,500 to AED 11,000, deposits, insurance coverage, weekend and weekly deals, age rules, documents needed, and the best model for every budget.
bodyHtml:
Dubai and Lamborghini go together like champagne and ice buckets. The city's glass towers, palm-shaped islands, and endless highway arteries were practically designed for a V10 symphony.

But there is a question every first-time renter asks before they click the booking button: how much does it actually cost to rent a Lamborghini in Dubai?

The short answer: anywhere from AED 2,500 (~USD 680) per day for a Huracan EVO Coupe to AED 11,000 (~USD 3,000) per day for the hybrid V12 Revuelto. But the full picture involves deposits, mileage limits, insurance, weekend rates, and which model gives you the most bang for your bucket-list budget.

Here is the complete 2026 price guide with real numbers from the Dubai rental market.

Lamborghini Rental Prices in Dubai — Complete Breakdown

All prices below are from Lamborghini rental in Dubai listings and include basic insurance. A 5% VAT applies to all bookings.

Weekend and Weekly Prices

Most Dubai rental companies offer discounts for multi-day bookings. Weekend rentals (Friday–Sunday) are especially popular because that is when Dubai comes alive — beach clubs, brunches, and evening cruises down Sheikh Zayed Road.

Typical Weekend Packages (3 days)

  • Huracan EVO Coupe: ~AED 6,750 (AED 2,250/day — 10% off daily rate)
  • Urus: ~AED 7,560 (AED 2,520/day — 10% off daily rate)
  • Huracan EVO Spyder: ~AED 8,100 (AED 2,700/day — 10% off daily rate)
  • Aventador SVJ Roadster: ~AED 24,300 (AED 8,100/day — 10% off daily rate)
  • Revuelto: ~AED 29,700 (AED 9,900/day — 10% off daily rate)

Typical Weekly Packages (7 days)

  • Huracan EVO Coupe: ~AED 14,875 (AED 2,125/day — 15% off daily rate)
  • Urus: ~AED 16,660 (AED 2,380/day — 15% off daily rate)
  • Huracan EVO Spyder: ~AED 17,850 (AED 2,550/day — 15% off daily rate)
  • Aventador SVJ Roadster: ~AED 53,550 (AED 7,650/day — 15% off daily rate)
  • Revuelto: ~AED 65,450 (AED 9,350/day — 15% off daily rate)

Deposit Information

Every Lamborghini rental in Dubai requires a refundable security deposit. The standard deposit across all models is AED 5,000 (~USD 1,360), regardless of whether you are renting a Huracan Coupe or a Revuelto.

The deposit is held as a temporary hold on your credit card (not a charge) and is released within 7–14 business days after the vehicle is returned in the same condition. Here is what you need to know:

  • Payment method: Credit or debit card. Cash deposits may be accepted by some companies but are less common for high-value vehicles.
  • American Express: A 5% transaction fee applies. Visa and Mastercard incur a 3% fee.
  • Excess waiver: Some companies offer a reduced deposit option (AED 2,500–3,000) for an extra daily fee — ask at booking.

Insurance Coverage

Basic comprehensive insurance is included in the daily rental price for all Lamborghini models listed above. This typically covers:

  • Collision damage (subject to the deposit excess)
  • Theft protection
  • Third-party liability

What is not covered: damage to tyres, wheels, undercarriage, windscreen, and interior. If you plan to drive to off-road areas or industrial zones, consider purchasing additional coverage.

Age Requirements

The minimum age to rent a Lamborghini in Dubai is 24 years old for the Huracan and Urus range, and 25 years old for the Aventador SVJ and Revuelto. Drivers under 25 may be able to rent with a higher deposit or additional fee — check with the rental company before booking.

You must also hold a valid driving licence for at least one year.

Documents Required

Renting a Lamborghini in Dubai is straightforward if you have the right paperwork. The requirements depend on where your licence was issued:

If your licence is from: US, UK, Canada, Australia, NZ, EU

  • Valid home country driving licence (no International Driving Permit needed)
  • Passport (original or copy)
  • Credit card for the security deposit

If your licence is from: India, China, Russia, Brazil, South Africa, or most other countries

  • Valid home country driving licence
  • International Driving Permit (IDP) — must be obtained before travel, cannot be issued in Dubai
  • Passport
  • Credit card for the security deposit

Tourist visas and visit visas are accepted. No Emirates ID is required for tourists.

Best Lamborghini Model for Every Budget

Budget: Under AED 3,000/day — Huracan EVO Coupe

The Huracan EVO Coupe is the most popular Lamborghini rental in Dubai for good reason. At AED 2,500/day, you get the full V10 experience — 602 hp, 0–100 km/h in 2.9 seconds, and that naturally aspirated engine note that no turbocharged rival can replicate. It is the sweet spot between price and theatre.

Budget: AED 2,800–3,000/day — Urus or Huracan Spyder

Need four seats and luggage room? The Lamborghini Urus is the world's first super SUV and starts at AED 2,800/day. It fits a golf bag, four adults, and still does 0–100 in 3.6 seconds. Ideal if you are splitting the cost with friends or need a car that works for dinner and the desert.

Want the drop-top experience? The Huracan EVO Spyder (AED 3,000–3,300/day) turns every traffic light into a photo opportunity. The roof retracts in 17 seconds and the V10 sounds even better with the sky as your ceiling.

Budget: AED 3,500–4,000/day — Tecnica or STO

The Huracan Tecnica (AED 3,500/day) is the driver's choice — rear-wheel drive, sharper steering, and a more focused chassis. It is the Lamborghini for someone who has driven a standard Huracan and wants more connection to the road.

The Huracan STO (AED 4,000/day) is a homologated race car with number plates. Carbon fibre body panels, a massive rear wing, and 631 hp. It is impractical, loud, and absolutely unforgettable. Rent it if you want the most extreme Lamborghini money can buy (short of the Revuelto).

Budget: AED 9,000+/day — Aventador SVJ or Revuelto

The Aventador SVJ Roadster (AED 9,000/day) is the last of the pure V12s. No hybrid assistance, no turbochargers — just 770 hp of naturally aspirated Italian thunder. At this price, you are paying for the experience of a lifetime.

The Lamborghini Revuelto (AED 11,000/day) is the future: a plug-in hybrid V12 producing 1,015 hp. It is the fastest, most technologically advanced Lamborghini ever made. If budget is no object, this is the one.

What Is Included in the Price

  • Comprehensive insurance (basic coverage, excess applies)
  • 250 km/day mileage limit (AED 20–30/km for additional kms)
  • Free delivery and collection anywhere in Dubai
  • 24/7 roadside assistance
  • Car wash and full tank of fuel on pickup (return with same fuel level)

Additional Costs to Budget For

  • VAT (5%) — applied to all rental prices
  • Credit card fee (3%) — for Visa/Mastercard payments
  • American Express fee (5%) — for Amex payments
  • Excess mileage — AED 20–30 per km beyond the daily limit
  • Salik (toll) — automatically charged, typically AED 4–12 per day depending on route
  • Fines — any speeding or parking fines incurred during the rental period

Tips for Getting the Best Price

  • Book mid-week: Monday–Thursday rates are often lower than weekend rates
  • Longer rentals: Weekly bookings almost always come with a 10–15% discount
  • Off-peak season: Summer (June–September) rates can be 20–30% lower than winter peak season
  • Book directly: Third-party aggregators often add margin — booking directly with a Dubai rental company can save 10–15%
  • Compare models: A Huracan EVO Coupe and an Urus cost almost the same per day — choose based on what you need, not just price

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the cheapest Lamborghini to rent in Dubai?

The Lamborghini Huracan Coupe and Huracan EVO Coupe start at AED 2,500/day (~USD 680), making them the most affordable entry point to the Lamborghini rental experience.

How much is the deposit for a Lamborghini rental in Dubai?

The standard refundable deposit is AED 5,000 (~USD 1,360) across all models, from the Huracan to the Revuelto.

Can I rent a Lamborghini in Dubai with a foreign licence?

Yes. If your licence is from the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, or the EU, you can drive on your home licence. Other nationalities need an International Driving Permit obtained before travel.

What is the minimum age to rent a Lamborghini in Dubai?

24 for the Huracan and Urus range, 25 for the Aventador SVJ and Revuelto. Drivers must have held their licence for at least one year.

Is insurance included when renting a Lamborghini in Dubai?

Yes, basic comprehensive insurance is included in the daily rate. It covers collision damage (subject to the excess), theft, and third-party liability. Damage to tyres, wheels, and windscreen is not covered.

What is the mileage limit on a Lamborghini rental in Dubai?

Most rentals include 250 km/day. Additional kilometres are charged at AED 20–30/km depending on the model.

Can I rent a Lamborghini for a week in Dubai?

Absolutely. Weekly rentals are common and typically include a 15% discount off the daily rate. A week in a Huracan EVO Coupe works out to approximately AED 14,875.

What is the most expensive Lamborghini to rent in Dubai?

The Lamborghini Revuelto hybrid V12 at AED 11,000/day (~USD 3,000). The Aventador SVJ Roadster is the next tier at AED 9,000/day.

Can I take a rental Lamborghini outside Dubai?

Most rental agreements cover the UAE mainland (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, etc.). Cross-border travel (e.g., to Oman) is generally not permitted. Always confirm the geographic limits with the rental company.

Do I need to return the Lamborghini with a full tank?

Yes. The car is delivered with a full tank and must be returned with a full tank, or you will be charged the refuelling cost plus a service fee.
